Movement order · From the airport

Land at Kochi. Turn east. Keep going.

Cochin International (COK) is the airport to fly into — not Trivandrum, not Calicut. Both venues sit east of it on the same road out of Perumbavoor, so the first half of the drive is identical whichever day you are arriving for.

COK → Enchanted Woods

≈ 25 km≈ 45 min06 Sept

  1. Leave COK on the Airport Road and join NH 544 at Angamaly.
  2. Head east on the Angamaly–Perumbavoor road, past Kalady.
  3. Through Perumbavoor town, then north on the Koovappady road.
  4. Arrive Enchanted Woods, Thottuvakavala, Koovappady.
Live directions

COK → Zenha Arena

≈ 40 km≈ 1 hr07 Sept

  1. Same road out of the airport as far as Perumbavoor.
  2. Continue south-east on the Perumbavoor–Kothamangalam road.
  3. Through Kothamangalam, then east on A M Road toward Nellikuzhi.
  4. Arrive Zenha Arena Convention Centre, Nellikuzhi.
Live directions

Distances

Approximate, and rounded kindly. Kerala traffic is a mood — leave a clear hour for either drive and more at school run or evening peak.

Getting a car

Prepaid taxi counters sit in the COK arrivals hall. Uber and Ola both work around Kochi; coverage thins out east of Perumbavoor, so book a return leg or ask us and we will arrange a car.

By train

Aluva is the nearest major railway station (about 15 minutes from the airport) and sits on the main Kochi line; Kochi's metro also terminates there.

Tell us your flight

Send us your arrival time and we will make sure someone is watching the gate. Nobody in this family lets a guest find their own way in.

Base camp · Where to stay

A bed near the airport, near the venue, or near the sea.

Three sensible ways to do it, depending on whether you are here for two nights or two weeks. September is the tail of the monsoon and shoulder season — rooms are easier and cheaper than in December, but book early anyway; a wedding fills a small town.

01 · Beside the airport

Saj Earth Resort & Convention Centre The big garden resort at Nedumbassery, minutes from the terminal. Pool, spa, room to spread out a jetlagged family. ≈ 5 min from COK
Airport transit hotels A cluster of small business hotels within 1–3 km of the terminal, most with a free shuttle. Right answer for a 4 AM departure. 1–3 km from COK
Best for Guests flying in the night before the wedding, or out the morning after the reception. Shortest transfers

02 · Beside the venues

VKJ International, Perumbavoor Air-conditioned business hotel in the middle of Perumbavoor town, ten minutes from Koovappady. ≈ 10 min from the wedding
Lilly Residency by Chungath Simple, clean, well reviewed, free parking. Perumbavoor again, so both venues are an easy hop. Perumbavoor
Kothamangalam guesthouses & homestays Small family-run places and riverside homestays five to ten minutes from Zenha Arena. Cash-friendly, generous breakfasts. ≈ 10 min from the reception

03 · Kochi city, for a longer stay

Grand Hyatt Kochi Bolgatty Backwater-front, on its own island, with the best pool in the city. Roughly an hour to the venues. Bolgatty Island
Kochi Marriott, Edappally Reliable five-star on the highway side of town, next to Lulu Mall if anyone needs to shop for a saree in a hurry. Edappally
Fort Kochi heritage homestays Colonial-era houses with courtyards and ceiling fans, a short walk from the fishing nets and the spice godowns. The romantic choice. Fort Kochi

Second unit · While you are here

You have flown a long way. Stay a few days.

Kerala calls itself God's Own Country and is insufferable about it, largely because it is true. Everything below is within reach of the wedding, sorted by how much of your week it will cost you.

Within an hour of the venues

Thattekad Bird Sanctuary Salim Ali's beloved patch of rainforest by the Periyar — hornbills, frogmouths, some 300 species. Go at first light with a local guide. ≈ 12 km from Kothamangalam
Bhoothathankettu A dam, a gorge and a legend about demons trying to bridge the river overnight. Easy walking, good picnic, dramatic in the rain. ≈ 10 km from Kothamangalam
Kodanad, on the Periyar River viewpoint and elephant-country forest edge just outside Perumbavoor — a gentle half-day if you are staying near the wedding. ≈ 20 min from Perumbavoor

A day out

Fort Kochi & Mattancherry Chinese fishing nets at sunset, the Paradesi Synagogue, Mattancherry Palace murals, St Francis Church, and Jew Town's spice and antique lanes. Book an evening Kathakali performance. ≈ 1 hr 30 from the venues
Athirappilly Falls Eighty feet of the Chalakudy river going over an edge, at its most theatrical right after the monsoon — which is exactly when you are here. ≈ 2 hrs
Alappuzha backwaters A day cruise through the rice paddies and canals, or an overnight houseboat with a cook aboard. The postcard, and worth it. ≈ 2 hrs 30

Worth a night or two

Munnar Tea hills to the horizon at 5,000 feet, and a genuinely cold night's sleep. The road climbs straight out of Kothamangalam, so it is the easy add-on from the reception. ≈ 3 hrs from Kothamangalam
Thekkady & Periyar Reserve Spice plantations, a lake full of elephants at dawn, bamboo rafting if you are brave about leeches. ≈ 3 hrs 30
Marari & Cherai beaches Palm-backed Arabian Sea sand for doing absolutely nothing. Cherai is the near one, an hour from the airport; Marari is the beautiful one. 1–2 hrs

Visas

Most passports can apply for an India e-Visa online — apply at least a couple of weeks out and print the approval. Fly into COK.

Weather in September

Warm and humid, 24–31°C, with the last of the monsoon passing through. Linen, sandals you can rinse, and a small umbrella.

Money & phones

Rupees; cards work in cities, cash east of them. UPI runs everything locally. Grab an Airtel or Jio tourist SIM at the airport.

Small courtesies

English is spoken everywhere in Kerala. Shoulders and knees covered at churches and temples, shoes off at the door, and say yes to the second helping — refusing food twice is considered a personality flaw.

What to wear

Morning ceremony: light formal, and something you can sit in warmly. Evening reception: dressier. Kerala saris and kurtas are very welcome and easy to buy in Kochi.

Power & plugs

230 V, 50 Hz, sockets type C/D/M. Bring a universal adapter; most hotels can lend one if you forget.

End of reel · Thank you for watching

See you in September.
